note: Versioned contact dynamics4ms for book covers/drawer bottoms to prevent observed bottom tunneling; same mass/friction/geometry/actuator forces/score. Whole-effector carry clearance and independent terminal braking enabled. Development, not controller-only comparison or formal evaluation. Full joint collision planning also required for the raised carry clearance, rather than an unchecked Cartesian lift. Release center x=.40 leaves forward room; after releasing, use a bounded real contact push only if the book is upright beyond the existing height limit.
